messages:
Sam: Quick sync: need to finalize how we expose status information to clients and how the Console surfaces it. We have a few inconsistent spots across routing/proxy layers.
Mira: Short version: separate machine-level signals from user-facing state. Proposal: publish a tiny client enum and keep HTTP semantics stable during rollout. Suggested enum: OK, RETRYABLE, THROTTLED, DEGRADED, OUTAGE.
Jordan: Agree with the enum. HTTP mapping proposal (initial):
Jordan: - THROTTLED => 429
Jordan: - RETRYABLE => 503 (with Retry-After) or 504 for gateway timeouts
Jordan: - DEGRADED => keep 200 but add explicit header/body signal
Alice: If we use 200 for DEGRADED we must add a non-ambiguous header plus body field. Otherwise monitoring/clients will treat as full success.
Mira: Proposed headers: `X-RW-Status: THROTTLED|DEGRADED|RETRYABLE|OUTAGE` and `X-RW-Trace: rwd-...`. Also add `Retryable: true|false` in the JSON error payload so SDKs can decide automatic retries.
infra-bot: Draft proposal posted: https://go/repo/err-taxonomy-draft (bot)
Sam: Console copy: show the enum as a badge and a short plain-language sentence for product folks, with a collapsible developer view showing HTTP code + example SDK advice. Example badge copy: `Degraded performance — served fallback model to meet latency SLOs.`
Priya: UX note: do not surface raw HTTP codes to end-users. Use friendly phrasing; provide a copyable developer panel that contains the header, payload example, and suggested retry/backoff snippet.
Jordan: Example minimal standardized error payload for clients (keep flat):
Jordan: ```json
Jordan: {"error": "THROTTLED", "http_status": 429, "message": "Rate limit exceeded for tenant.", "hint": "retry-after: 30", "retryable": true, "trace_id": "rwd-xyz789"}
Jordan: ```
Alice: +1 include trace_id and retryable. Server infra: ensure proxies and CDNs do not drop `X-RW-Trace`. I'll add tests.
Mira: Rollout compatibility: do not change existing HTTP codes for GA customers. Plan: first emit headers + body field; after 2-week opt-in toggle, advertise SDK parsing of header+payload.
Sam: Good. Backwards compatibility plan documented: header-first, then SDK changes, then optional Console flag.
Priya: Telemetry view: surface counts by tenant, route, model, and status enum. Provide a sample column: last 10 traces (linkable), percent of requests in DEGRADED per minute, and heatmap for throttled spikes.
Jordan: SDK contract: if `retryable=true`, SDKs can perform exponential backoff up to configured attempts. We'll document defaults per enum (e.g., THROTTLED: backoff up to 5 attempts with capped jitter).
Mira: Small API detail: prefer a string `type` rather than nested objects for error.type to keep parsing trivial in many languages. Flat payload ensures no deep parsing.
Sam: Action items:
Sam: - Mira: update PR to include `X-RW-Status`, `retryable` flag, and flat payload example (ETA: EOD today).
Sam: - Jordan: draft SDK snippet page and retry defaults (ETA: Tue).
Sam: - Alice: add proxy tests for `X-RW-Trace` passthrough and header unit tests (ETA: Wed).
Sam: - Priya: mock Console badges + developer panel and post Figma links to #product (ETA: Thu).
Sam: - Devex: prepare example snippets for docs (pseudocode for auto-retry, header parsing) (ETA: Fri).
Mira: tiny question: do we want a separate HTTP 206 for partial/degraded responses? I'm leaning no — stick to 200 + header because 206 implies range semantics and could confuse caches.
Jordan: Agreed, keep 200 + header.
Alice: infra OK. I will also add a debug-only header `X-RW-Debug` when running in internal mode to help ops correlate.
Priya: :thumbsup: I'll ensure the Console copy avoids technical jargon and provides a single-click copy for the dev view.
Sam: If nobody objects I'll merge the header-first approach and start the opt-in SDK rollouts. Revisit in next sync after PR updates.
devex: I'll upload sample snippets and a short gif showing click-to-copy retry code in the docs.
Sam: Thanks team, nice progress. :rocket:
